_comment: LAST CALL 3 board graph. 'main' is the loop (walked in order, start at 0). 'branches' leave the loop at 'from' and rejoin at 'to', through their own spaces; a junction asks which way. 'toll' Teeth (or a Shortcut Key) to take it. 'rat_spots': main-loop indices the Dead Rat can sit on (buy it for 'rat_price' Teeth when you pass or land). Space types: start normal bad event item shop black_market medical minigame duel battle roulette resurrect poison gamble caller trap hidden rulebook veto clue door note.
name: THE FUNCTION ROOM

main.text: The wallpaper here is peeling. Underneath, in crayon: a number, and an arrow toward the door. 'IT ISN'T PAINTED ON.'
Inside a crushed party hat: a number inked on the band. 'THE BOMB HAS A KEY. IT WON'T LET ONE PERSON WIND IT.'
A photo pinned under a chair: last year's contestants at the door, all pushing at once. A number on the back.

branches.name: THE ABATTOIR
branches.desc: Short. Nasty. The black market's down here.

branches.name: THE CHAPEL
branches.desc: The long way round. Quieter. Someone prays here.

branches.name: THE MEAT LOCKER
branches.desc: A shortcut through the cold. Six Teeth to the man at the door, or a key.

notes: A name tag on the floor: HELLO MY NAME IS ___. Someone has written underneath: 'he can't count us if we hold hands'.
Scratched into the skirting board: 'THE POPPER DOESN'T GO OFF IF NOBODY PICKS IT UP. WE TRIED. ALL OF US.'
